name: which.sync
summary: Find the first instance of an executable in the PATH.

docs.t: Find the first instance of an executable in the PATH.
Like the unix `which` utility. Finds the first instance of a specified executable in the PATH environment variable. Does not cache the results, so `hash -r` is not needed when the PATH changes.

fails.when: if it isn't on PATH, unless nothrow

uses.text: resolved = which.sync(parsed.command, { path: env[getPathKey({ env })], pathExt: withoutPathExt ? path.delimiter : undef…;

workspace: two node_modules trees (no JavaScript in your workspace)

siblings.name: which
siblings.differs: later: a Promise, or a callback

facts: which ships no types: no .d.ts, no JSDoc. Every type here is read from its code or its README.
